description: Assess a project's declared dependency licences and supply-chain hygiene: copyleft and commercially restricted licences, undeclared licences, install-time scripts, URL-sourced packages, leaked credentials in the lockfile and tracked credential files, with a risk score and grade. Before adopting or shipping a dependency set, for a licence-obligation and supply-chain hygiene review. Do not choose this when you need the full resolved dependency tree or a legal opinion on licence compatibility. Example requests: Check my dependencies for copyleft and restricted licences. | Audit my supply chain for install scripts and leaked secrets. | Which of my dependencies have an unknown or undeclared licence? | Run a licence and supply-chain audit over these files.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

licences.description: The customer's licences.txt, as text. Supported: Text. Declared licences as 'dependency=LICENCE' lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

lockfile.description: The customer's lockfile.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The lockfile or resolved dependency list. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

manifest.description: The customer's manifest.json, as text. Supported: JSON or text. The dependency manifest (package.json, requirements, etc.). Maximum 1048576 bytes.

tracked_files.description: The customer's tracked_files.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The repository's tracked file list, one path per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_supply_chain_licence_audit

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Supply-chain and licence audit
